description: Import the text library of a generated document and regenerate it if active. Give the library inline or as library_file, a local .json path (e.g. websites/bin/legal-v4/privacy/library-datenschutz.json). A library using the 'accessibility' flag needs cvrt-legal 0.8.0+ on the site first.

doc.description: Generated document: impressum, datenschutz or barrierefreiheit (BFSG statement, cvrt-legal 0.9.0+)

library.description: Library object as library.py emits it

library_file.description: Absolute path to a local .json library file

name: legal_put_generator_library
